title: Cheam Emergency Help Points
summary: Emergency medical locations, hazard alerts, and essential supply points for Cheam (SM2, SM3).
content: For immediate life-threatening emergencies, always dial 999 or 112 first. 1. Nearest 24-Hour A&E Hospitals: St Helier Hospital, Wrythe Lane, Carshalton SM5 1AA. Travel guidance: from Cheam station, ~40 min walk north-east along Malden Road and A232/Carshalton Road, or take bus 151 or SL7 directly towards St Helier. Epsom Hospital, Dorking Road, Epsom KT18 7EG. Travel guidance: from Cheam Broadway, ~12 min drive or take bus 470 or 293 towards Epsom. For major trauma, St George's Hospital (Major Trauma Centre), Blackshaw Road, Tooting SW17 0QT. Travel guidance: from Cheam station, take Southern rail to Balham/Tooting or bus 213 to Sutton then bus 280 to Tooting. 2. Urgent Treatment Centres: St Helier Urgent Treatment Centre, located on-site at St Helier Hospital, Wrythe Lane, Carshalton SM5 1AA (co-located with A&E). Sutton Health Care Walk-in Centre, Robin Hood Lane Health Centre, Camden Road, Sutton SM1 2RJ (~25 min walk east from Cheam Village). 3. Area Hazards: Surface water flood risk along the Pyl Brook corridor through north Cheam and around Cheam Park depressions during heavy storm rainfall. 4. Essential Supplies: Pharmacies and larger supermarkets along Cheam Broadway, High Street, and London Road (A24 corridor) can supply drinking water, first-aid items, and emergency over-the-counter medicines during power outages. Note: addresses and opening hours may have changed — confirm on arrival where possible.
